Show Sakura Bakushin O, Yamanin Zephyr
Outfit: Both in Summer Tracksuits
Because the people precious to me said I gave them courage.

...I—I... don't want to give up...!
No, I haven't given up!

That's exactly why her dream will come true. She can make it come true.
She can become a blooming flower not just for herself, but for so many others.

Yes, yes. Your father and I got courage from you.
We realized there's no need to shrink back—we should hold our heads up high.

—For a while, I think you'll need to focus on rehabilitation.
I'll call a car so we can have you examined at the hospital just in case.

Huh, Sky-san? ...You're going to sleep in the infirmary?
That's unusual. On sunny days, you always take your naps outside...

I wanted... to make my dream... come true... ugh, ah...
...*sob*... ugh... *sniff*, waah...

...Th-Thank... you so much...!
I'll do my best... So, so please...!

No matter how small a flower is, seeing it bloom gives me courage.
That's why... I wanted to be like that too, which is what brought me here.

Seiun Sky gave a lazy wave and strolled off at her own leisurely pace.
I watched with a warm feeling in my heart as Nishino Flower fell into step beside her.
...*sniff*, yes...

Fufu. Flowers dance upon the wind, so to keep them from obscuring my sight,
I suppose I must become the wind myself.
Even when overwhelmed by the gap in our abilities, I was determined to do my best.

I'm still a child, but... *sniff*, if I t-try hard... *hic*,
so I wouldn't get left behind by everyone... I, I...
Hmm? Whatever could you mean~?

It would be easy to simply deny it and tell her she's wrong.
But more than that, the feeling welling up inside me now was—

I tell Nishino Flower once more.
How her efforts had encouraged me, and how she had saved me.
And yet...

Running on an injured leg like that...
Worried, I immediately ran after her.

Because... I gave you courage, didn't I?
From me... truly...

There, there, good girl. It's okay. Once you go through proper rehab,
you'll be able to train again. For now, let's take it easy, alright?

Oh~ Flower, are you headed to the infirmary too? Leave a bed for
Sei-chan, okay~? I'm in just the mood for a nap. *yaaaawn*...

Ah, I can go on my own, so please don't worry about me!
I already made you run after me, Trainer, so I shouldn't cause you any more trouble...

...You chased after me, didn't you?
I'm sorry for running away...
Tears welling in her eyes, Nishino Flower dashed off.
...Yes.

Even though your budding period has begun, your body is still developing.
If you push yourself too hard, the consequences will be immediate. ...You understand, right?

If that were true, she certainly wouldn't have come here.
Right in front of the flowers that give her encouragement.

"Gotta switch it up sometimes," Seiun Sky said with a deadpan face.
Yet for a split second, her gaze drifted down to Nishino Flower's leg—

Looking at flowers always gives me encouragement.
It makes me want to try harder and harder.
...I-I'm so sorry!
Looking forward to working together!
...It's my favorite place.
Eh...
Ah...
I'm so, so... rry... I shouldn't be... like this...

Watching you run, Flower-chan, somehow filled me with confidence.
After all, our precious treasure was shining so brightly out there.

Ah, Sky-san, please wait for me!
Well then, Trainer, see you tomorrow...!

...And yet, I ended up getting hurt. Even though I knew
better... than to push myself so recklessly...

Her slender shoulders trembling, Nishino Flower wept.
No doubt frustrated at her own perceived helplessness.

Mmh! In that case, let us have a rematch!
Next time, I will secure a clear and decisive victory without fail!

I walked back to the academy with a smiling Nishino Flower.
Starting tomorrow, we'll join forces and strive toward her dream.
A breathtaking array of vivid, beautiful flowers decorated the surrounding area.

...Trainer...
I-I... wanted to give you... courage, and yet...

During the Umamusumes' training session, I spotted Nishino Flower.
...Seeing the way she favored one leg, I immediately realized she was injured.

Chasing after that small back, I arrived at a spot
where—

Well then, thank you so much for today.
I'll be heading back to the classroom now.
